description: Planeamiento urbanístico de Puerto de La Cruz is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. Systematized urban planning of the municipality of Puerto de La Cruz. This information is produced and maintained by the Government of the Canary Islands and has been financed by the Ministry of Development, through the Network Urbanism Program executed by the public company Red.es, during the period 2010-2015. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. The portal shows the English title as "Urban planning of Puerto de La Cruz" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://datos.canarias.es/portal/aviso-legal-y-condiciones-de-uso). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
